findings.location: “But Kenny was there. As Jamin clumped into the meadow, he could see a frustrated heap to his right. The heap’s voice had a familiar ring. The heap’s face was lit in pain. The heap was Kenny. “Are you alright? What happened?” Jamin felt strange, seeing Kenny scrunched in the dirt. Kenny was smart. “Did you step in a trap?”
